metadata.description: Bypass config for @aipass citizen. Pruned 2026-08-13 (S112, DPLAN-0291 round): 85 rules -> 27. Removed 8 rules whose target file no longer exists and 50 proven inert by CONTROL RUN in BOTH lanes (audit lane: audit_branch with bypass_rules=[]; checklist lane: drone @seedgo checklist per-directory with bypass emptied). 9 further rules the audit lane called dead were LIVE in the checklist lane and were kept - measuring one lane only would have deleted them. Remaining rules cover: binary-invocation introspection (bare aipass <cmd> runs, --info for introspection), thin entry-point router, pure-python bootstrap that runs before AIPass services exist, shared/ helpers checked by the checklist lane, and CLI flag NAME references (permission_flags). Editing this file is @aipass's own call per Patrick's S46 ruling, reaffirmed by @devpulse 2026-08-13.

bypass.reason: wants_help() is a pure predicate - no I/O, no JSON, no logging - called on EVERY command dispatch before any action runs. Importing json_handler would add a write path and a failure surface to the one function whose whole job is to stop a help probe becoming a write. Measured: the file performs zero JSON operations, so json_handler would be imported solely to satisfy the checker. Fleet-settled shape (DPLAN-0291 help_flag_safety round).
12-stage init flow requires this many lines; splitting would scatter cohesive stage logic across multiple files and break the resumable-progress contract.
Doctor reads system files (registry, passport) directly for health-check diagnosis — pure reads only, no mutations. Using a handler adds indirection without benefit for diagnostic reads.

Called from setup.sh's venv-python heredoc via dynamic import (setup.sh:704-707, DPLAN-0279) — a cross-language caller the AST/corpus scanner can't see. That heredoc is its ONLY caller: auto_wire_provider is a sibling, not a chain (both call _strip_and_readd_hooks independently), so there is no in-process Python caller to make this reachable. Covered directly by tests/test_provider_wire.py. Verified live 2026-08-09.
